comment: Vreta's StixGames 3D grass shader values, tuned by hand by Marcus in the editor for look and frame time (GreenKeeper flyover: Stix on top of the VSP vegetation was the largest cost). The editor reads the copy in the course folder (Assets/GolfMap/Omberg/stix.json): golfmap.roughgrass.plant sets 'rough' on NewRough, golfmap.wispy.build sets 'wispy' / 'wispyFloor' on the materials it derives (wispy rough is VSP only on Vreta since 2026-10-14, so those two are not in use). 'before' = the values until the hand tuning, for comparing frame times (golfmap.stix.apply which=before|current); 'history' = the steps. golfmap.stix.read shows the live values.
